<script>window.OREXIS=1;window.OREXIS_LOGO="data:image/png;base64,"</script><title>Orexis Hourly</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@500;600;700&family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#f6f4f4; --panel:#ffffff; --ink:#111111; --muted:#5f5759; --line:#e2dcdd;
  --accent:#424965; --accent-ink:#ffffff; --accent-soft:#fbe7cf; --dark:#1f2a2a;
  --ok:#17844f; --warn:#b86e00; --bad:#c23a2b;
  color-scheme:light;
  --display:"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",Arial,sans-serif;
  --body:"Figtree",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--body);font-size:15px;line-height:1.4}
button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);padding:8px 12px;touch-action:manipulation}
button.primary{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);font-weight:700}
button:disabled{opacity:.5}
input,textarea,select{font:inherit;font-size:16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:9px 10px;background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);width:100%}
textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:64px}
.wrap{max-width:720px;margin:0 auto;padding:14px 14px calc(96px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.top img{width:44px;height:44px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:10px}
.top h1{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.45rem;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.01em;white-space:nowrap}
.top .ib{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:44px;height:44px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);color:var(--accent);text-decoration:none;font-size:1.1rem;padding:0}
.top .sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem}
.top .sp{flex:1}
.card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px}
.sect{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--muted);margin:14px 0 6px}
.fold{padding:0;overflow:hidden;margin-top:8px}.fold.open{border:2px solid var(--accent)}
.foldh{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px;cursor:pointer;min-height:56px}
.foldh .ft{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}.foldh small{color:var(--muted);font-size:.82rem}.foldh small.ok{color:var(--ok)}.foldh .chev{color:var(--muted)}
.foldb{padding:0 14px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.pills{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.pills button{min-height:40px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600}.pills button.on{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
.tgprev{background:var(--bg);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;font-size:.82rem;white-space:pre-wrap;max-height:220px;overflow:auto;margin:0;font-family:inherit}
.banner{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:10px}.banner b{flex:1}.banner button{background:#fff;color:var(--accent);border:0;font-weight:700}
.morectr{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 2px 2px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}.morectr span{color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.card h2{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.15rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;margin:0 0 10px}
.lbl{font-size:.74rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:4px;display:block}
.row2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.row3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}
.daybar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.daybar button{min-width:46px;min-height:46px;font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700}
.daybar .d{flex:1;text-align:center;font-weight:700}
.daybar .d small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;font-size:.78rem}
.seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;background:var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:3px;gap:3px}
.seg button{border:none;background:none;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);padding:9px}
.seg button.on{background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
.tgt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}
.tgt input{text-align:center;font-weight:700}
.hrs{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:4px;scrollbar-width:none}
.hrs button{flex:none;min-width:48px;min-height:48px;font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;position:relative}
.hrs button.on{background:var(--dark);border-color:var(--dark);color:#fff}
.hrs button.hit::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:5px;top:5px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok)}
.hrs button.miss::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:5px;top:5px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bad)}
.hourhead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:var(--dark);color:#fff;border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;margin:-14px -14px 12px;padding:10px 14px}
.hourhead b{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.4rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.hitpill{font-weight:700;font-size:.8rem;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.15)}
.hitpill.hy{background:var(--ok)}.hitpill.hn{background:var(--bad)}
.tally{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.tb{border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:10px 10px 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;background:var(--panel)}
.tb .tn{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline}
.tb .tn span{font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--muted)}
.tb .tn em{font-style:normal;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--muted)}
.tb .big{font-family:var(--display);font-size:2.6rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1;text-align:center}
.tb .ctl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr;gap:6px}
.tb .ctl button{min-height:64px;font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:700;padding:0}
.tb .ctl button.add{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.tb.money .big{font-size:2rem}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.chips{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
.chips button{min-height:42px;padding:6px 4px;font-weight:700}
.tb .other{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:6px}.tb .other input{flex:1;min-width:0}.chips .minus{color:var(--bad)}
.tb .dots{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:3px;min-height:12px;justify-content:center}
.tb .dots i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--accent);display:block}
table.grid{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.9rem}
table.grid th{background:var(--dark);color:#fff;font-family:var(--display);font-size:1rem;padding:6px 2px;text-transform:uppercase}
table.grid td{border:1px solid var(--line);padding:2px;text-align:center}
table.grid td.h{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:1.15rem;background:var(--bg);width:34px}
table.grid input{border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 2px;text-align:center;font-weight:600;background:transparent;min-width:0}
table.grid input:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft)}
table.grid tr.tot td{background:#e9eeee;font-weight:800}
table.grid .hitc{font-weight:800}
.y{color:var(--ok)}.n{color:var(--bad)}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}
.stat{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:10px;text-align:center}
.stat .v{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.9rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1}
.stat .k{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}
.sync{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sync button{padding:6px 12px;font-weight:700}
.savebar{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:var(--panel);border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px 14px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;z-index:40;box-shadow:0 -4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.savebar .st{flex:1;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted)}
.savebar button{min-height:48px;min-width:120px}
.team{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.85rem}
.team th,.team td{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:7px 4px;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}
.team th:first-child,.team td:first-child{text-align:left}
.team small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.7rem}
.scroll{overflow-x:auto}
.hint{color:var(--muted);font-size:.82rem}
#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:calc(84px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s;z-index:90;max-width:90vw;text-align:center}
#toast.show{opacity:1}
.empty{padding:30px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)}
:root{--bg:#F6F3EE!important;--line:#e3dfd7!important;--muted:#5b6275!important;--ink:#1E2740!important;--accent:#2E3A59!important;--accent-soft:#fbe7cf!important}body{background:#F6F3EE!important}header.top,.top{--muted:#c9cfe0!important;--line:#5a6688!important;background:#2E3A59!important;color:#F5B56E!important;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px!important;margin-bottom:10px}header.top h1,.top h1,#teamTitle{color:#F5B56E!important;letter-spacing:.12em}#teamSub,.top .sub{color:#c9cfe0!important}header.top button,.top button,header.top input,header.top select{background:#414A63!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#5a6688!important}nav.tabs button[aria-selected=true]{border-bottom-color:#F5B56E!important}#mnav button[aria-selected=true]{color:#2E3A59!important;background:#fbe7cf!important}h2,h3{color:#2E3A59}.card{border-color:#e3dfd7}.top{gap:10px!important}.top>div:not(.sp){min-width:0}.top h1{font-size:clamp(1.05rem,5.4vw,1.6rem)!important;letter-spacing:.05em!important;line-height:1.05!important}.top .ib{flex:none!important;width:40px!important;height:40px!important;min-width:40px!important;border-radius:50%!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28)!important;color:#F5B56E!important;font-size:1.05rem!important;padding:0!important}.top img{flex:none}button{white-space:nowrap}@keyframes pop{0%{transform:scale(.6);opacity:0}80%{transform:scale(1.06)}100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}</style>
<base target="_top">
<div id="login" hidden>
  <div class="lgbox">
    <img id="lgLogo" alt="" hidden>
    <h1 id="lgName">Orexis Hourly</h1>
    <div class="lgtabs" role="tablist">
      <button id="lgTabIn" class="on" type="button">Log in</button>
      <button id="lgTabNew" type="button">Create my login</button>
    </div>
    <form id="lgIn">
      <label for="lgUser">Your name</label>
      <input id="lgUser" type="text" autocomplete="username" placeholder="First and last name">
      <label for="lgPin">PIN</label>
      <input id="lgPin" type="password" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="4 to 8 digits">
      <button class="primary" type="submit">Log in</button>
      <p class="lghint">Forgot your PIN? Ask Orexis admin to reset it.</p>
    </form>
    <form id="lgNew" hidden>
      <label for="nwUser">Your name</label>
      <input id="nwUser" type="text" placeholder="First and last name">
      <label for="nwPin">Choose a PIN</label>
      <input id="nwPin" type="password" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="4 to 8 digits">
      <label for="nwPin2">PIN again</label>
      <input id="nwPin2" type="password" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="4 to 8 digits">
      <label for="nwTeam" hidden>Your team</label>
      <select id="nwTeam" hidden></select>
      <button class="primary" type="submit">Create my login</button>
      <p class="lghint">Only you and your leaders see your detail. Your weekly totals go on the shared leaderboard.</p>
    </form>
    <p id="lgMsg" class="lgmsg" role="alert"></p>
  </div>
</div>
<style>
#login{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:var(--bg);display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;overflow:auto;padding:max(40px,env(safe-area-inset-top)) 16px 40px}
.lgbox{width:100%;max-width:400px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.lgbox h1{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:2rem;margin:0;text-align:center}
#lgLogo{width:72px;height:72px;object-fit:contain;margin:0 auto;border-radius:12px}
.lgtabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:10px;padding:4px}
.lgtabs button{border:none;background:none;padding:8px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}
.lgtabs button.on{background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.lgbox form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
#login[hidden],.lgbox [hidden]{display:none!important}
.lgbox label{font-size:.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-top:6px}
.lgbox input,.lgbox select{font:inherit;font-size:1.05rem;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}
.lgbox button.primary{margin-top:12px;padding:11px}
.lghint{color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem;margin:6px 0 0}
.lgmsg{color:var(--bad);font-weight:600;min-height:1.2em;margin:0}
#logoutBtn{font-size:.8rem;padding:4px 10px}
</style>
<script>
/* Orexis KPIs on Google: a small database client that talks to Code.gs and
   looks like the claude.use("db") / claude.use("user") API the app is written against. */
(function(){
  window.KAIZEN_GOOGLE=true;
  const TOK='kaizen_token';
  const ls={get:k=>{try{return localStorage.getItem(k)}catch(e){return null}},set:(k,v)=>{try{localStorage.setItem(k,v)}catch(e){}},del:k=>{try{localStorage.removeItem(k)}catch(e){}}};
  function call(fn,...args){return new Promise((res,rej)=>{google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(res).withFailureHandler(e=>rej(e))[fn](...args)})}
  let session=null;let sessionReady;const ready=new Promise(r=>sessionReady=r);
  const store={};const listeners=new Set();let since=0;let syncing=false;let pending=false;
  /* ---- local store + live queries ---- */
  function snapDoc(path){const d=store[path];return{id:path.split('/').pop(),exists:!!d,data:()=>d,metadata:{fromCache:false,hasPendingWrites:false}}}
  function childDocs(path){const n=path.split('/').length+1;return Object.keys(store).filter(k=>k.startsWith(path+'/')&&k.split('/').length===n)}
  function runQuery(path,f,ob,lim){let ks=childDocs(path);
    let docs=ks.map(snapDoc).filter(d=>f.every(([fld,op,v])=>{const x=d.data()[fld];
      return op==='=='?x===v:op==='!='?x!==v:op==='<'?x<v:op==='<='?x<=v:op==='>'?x>v:op==='>='?x>=v:op==='in'?(v||[]).includes(x):op==='not-in'?!(v||[]).includes(x):op==='array-contains'?Array.isArray(x)&&x.includes(v):true}));
    if(ob){const [fld,dir]=ob;docs.sort((a,b)=>{const x=a.data()[fld],y=b.data()[fld];if(x===y)return 0;if(x==null)return 1;if(y==null)return -1;return(x<y?-1:1)*(dir==='desc'?-1:1)})}
    else docs.sort((a,b)=>a.id<b.id?-1:a.id>b.id?1:0);
    if(lim)docs=docs.slice(0,lim);
    return{docs,size:docs.length,empty:!docs.length,docChanges:()=>[],metadata:{fromCache:false,hasPendingWrites:false}}}
  function notify(){listeners.forEach(l=>l.run())}
  function addListener(compute,fn){const l={last:null,run(){let r;try{r=compute()}catch(e){return}const sig=JSON.stringify(r.docs?r.docs.map(d=>[d.id,d.data()]):[r.exists,r.data()]);if(sig===l.last)return;l.last=sig;try{fn(r)}catch(e){console.error(e)}}};
    listeners.add(l);ready.then(()=>setTimeout(()=>l.run(),0));return()=>listeners.delete(l)}
  function merge(a,b){const o={...(a||{})};for(const k in b){const v=b[k];o[k]=v&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v)&&o[k]&&typeof o[k]==='object'&&!Array.isArray(o[k])?merge(o[k],v):v}return o}
  function applyDocs(docs){(docs||[]).forEach(x=>{if(x.del)delete store[x.p];else store[x.p]=x.d})}
  /* ---- sync with the sheet ---- */
  async function sync(full){if(!session)return;if(syncing){pending=true;return}syncing=true;
    try{const r=await call('sync',session.token,full?0:Math.max(0,since-3000));
      if(r.full){Object.keys(store).forEach(k=>delete store[k])}
      applyDocs(r.docs);since=r.now;reapply();if(outbox.length)flush();
      if(r.me&&(r.me.role!==session.role)){session.role=r.me.role;ls.set(TOK,JSON.stringify(session));location.reload();return}
      notify()}
    catch(e){if(String(e&&e.message||e).includes('AUTH')){logoutLocal();return}}
    finally{syncing=false;if(pending){pending=false;setTimeout(()=>sync(false),200)}}}
  let timer=null;function startPolling(){clearInterval(timer);timer=setInterval(()=>{if(document.visibilityState==='visible')sync(false)},40000);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.visibilityState==='visible')sync(false)});setInterval(()=>sync(true),10*60000)}
  /* ---- offline outbox: writes made with no signal are kept on the phone and sent when it's back ---- */
  const OBK=()=>'kaizen_outbox_'+(session&&session.uid||'');let outbox=[];let flushing=false;
  function loadOutbox(){try{outbox=JSON.parse(ls.get(OBK())||'[]')||[]}catch(_){outbox=[]}badge()}
  function saveOutbox(){ls.set(OBK(),JSON.stringify(outbox));badge()}
  function isNet(e){const m=String(e&&e.message||e);return !/AUTH|DENIED|MISSING|BAD_PATH|TOO_LARGE|Only Ameliah|Enter your|PIN/.test(m)}
  function queue(ops){outbox.push(ops);saveOutbox();setTimeout(flush,4000)}
  function reapply(){outbox.forEach(ops=>ops.forEach(o=>{if(o.op==='delete')delete store[o.path];else if(o.op==='update')store[o.path]=merge(store[o.path]||{},o.data);else store[o.path]=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o.data))}))}
  function badge(){let b=document.getElementById('syncBadge');if(!b){b=document.createElement('div');b.id='syncBadge';b.setAttribute('role','status');
      b.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);top:calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-top));z-index:80;background:#8a6100;color:#fff;font:600 13px/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.18);cursor:pointer';
      b.onclick=()=>flush();document.body.append(b)}
    const n=outbox.length;b.hidden=!n;b.textContent=n?('No signal \u2014 '+n+' change'+(n>1?'s':'')+' saved on this phone, will send automatically'):''}
  async function flush(){if(flushing||!session||!outbox.length)return;flushing=true;
    try{while(outbox.length){const ops=outbox[0];
        try{const r=await call('write',session.token,ops);outbox.shift();saveOutbox();applyDocs(r.docs)}
        catch(e){if(isNet(e))break;outbox.shift();saveOutbox();const m=String(e&&e.message||e).replace(/^Error: /,'');
          try{const t=document.getElementById('toast');if(t){t.textContent='A change made offline couldn\u2019t be saved: '+m;t.classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),5000)}}catch(_){}}}
      reapply();notify()}
    finally{flushing=false;if(outbox.length)setTimeout(flush,30000)}}
  window.addEventListener('online',()=>setTimeout(flush,1500));
  async function doWrite(ops){
    const backup={};ops.forEach(o=>backup[o.path]=store[o.path]);
    ops.forEach(o=>{if(o.op==='delete')delete store[o.path];else if(o.op==='update'){if(!store[o.path])throw{code:'invalid_argument',message:'Document does not exist'};store[o.path]=merge(store[o.path],o.data)}else store[o.path]=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o.data))});
    notify();
    if(outbox.length){queue(ops);return}
    try{const r=await call('write',session.token,ops);applyDocs(r.docs);notify()}
    catch(e){if(isNet(e)){queue(ops);return}Object.keys(backup).forEach(p=>{if(backup[p]===undefined)delete store[p];else store[p]=backup[p]});notify();
      const m=String(e&&e.message||e);if(m.includes('AUTH')){logoutLocal();throw{code:'revoked',message:m}}
      throw{code:m.includes('DENIED')||m.includes('MISSING')||m.includes('BAD_PATH')?'invalid_argument':m.includes('TOO_LARGE')?'quota_exceeded':'unavailable',message:m}}}
  function docRef(path){return{id:path.split('/').pop(),path,
    get:async()=>{await ready;return snapDoc(path)},
    set:async d=>{await ready;return doWrite([{op:'set',path,data:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d))}])},
    update:async d=>{await ready;return doWrite([{op:'update',path,data:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d))}])},
    delete:async()=>{await ready;return doWrite([{op:'delete',path}])},
    onSnapshot:(fn)=>addListener(()=>snapDoc(path),fn),
    collection:p=>colRef(path+'/'+p)}}
  function colRef(path,f=[],ob=null,lim=0){const self={path,
    where:(fld,op,v)=>colRef(path,f.concat([[fld,op,v]]),ob,lim),orderBy:(fld,dir)=>colRef(path,f,[fld,dir||'asc'],lim),limit:n=>colRef(path,f,ob,n),
    get:async()=>{await ready;return runQuery(path,f,ob,lim)},
    onSnapshot:(fn)=>addListener(()=>runQuery(path,f,ob,lim),fn),
    doc:id=>docRef(path+'/'+(id||('d'+Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8)))),
    add:async d=>{const r=self.doc();await r.set(d);return r}};return self}
  const db={doc:docRef,collection:p=>colRef(p)};
  const user={id:async()=>{await ready;return session.uid},isOwner:async()=>{await ready;return session.role==='owner'},canEdit:async()=>{await ready;return session.role==='owner'||session.role==='tl'},
    can:async()=>{await ready;return session.role==='owner'},me:async()=>{await ready;return{id:session.uid,name:session.name,isOwner:session.role==='owner',canEdit:session.role!=='rep',email:null,avatarUrl:'',color:'#424965'}},
    profiles:async ids=>{const o={};(Array.isArray(ids)?ids:[ids]).forEach(i=>o[i]={id:i,name:'',avatarUrl:'',color:'#424965',email:null,isMe:i===(session&&session.uid),guest:false});return o},name:async()=>session.name};
  window.claude={use:async n=>{await ready;return n==='db'?db:n==='user'?user:null}};
  window.kaizenAdmin={list:()=>call('adminAccess',session.token,'list'),act:(a,uid,v)=>call('adminAccess',session.token,a,uid,v)};
  const FD='https://ameliahcrowe-cloud.github.io';function fdPost(m){try{window.top.postMessage(m,FD)}catch(e){}}
  function logoutLocal(){ls.del(TOK);fdPost({kz:'clear'});location.reload()}
  window.kaizenLogout=async()=>{try{if(session)await call('logout',session.token)}catch(e){}logoutLocal()};
  /* ---- login screen ---- */
  async function start(sess){session=sess;ls.set(TOK,JSON.stringify(sess));fdPost({kz:'save',v:JSON.stringify(sess)});loadOutbox();document.getElementById('login').hidden=true;
    await sync(true);sessionReady();startPolling()}
  function showLogin(info){const L=document.getElementById('login');L.hidden=false;const msg=document.getElementById('lgMsg');
    if(info){if(window.OREXIS_LOGO)info.logo=window.OREXIS_LOGO;if(info.logo){const im=document.getElementById('lgLogo');im.src=info.logo;im.hidden=false}
      const sel=document.getElementById('nwTeam');sel.replaceChildren();const o0=document.createElement('option');o0.value='';o0.textContent=info.name||'Orexis Innovations';sel.append(o0);
      (info.teams||[]).forEach(t=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=t.id;o.textContent=t.name;sel.append(o)});
      if(!info.hasOwner)msg.textContent='Setup isn’t finished yet. Ameliah: open the spreadsheet and use the Orexis KPIs menu to set your PIN.'}
    const tabIn=document.getElementById('lgTabIn'),tabNew=document.getElementById('lgTabNew'),fIn=document.getElementById('lgIn'),fNew=document.getElementById('lgNew');
    tabIn.onclick=()=>{tabIn.classList.add('on');tabNew.classList.remove('on');fIn.hidden=false;fNew.hidden=true;msg.textContent=''};
    tabNew.onclick=()=>{tabNew.classList.add('on');tabIn.classList.remove('on');fNew.hidden=false;fIn.hidden=true;msg.textContent=''};
    const busy=(f,b)=>f.querySelectorAll('button,input,select').forEach(x=>x.disabled=b);
    fIn.onsubmit=async e=>{e.preventDefault();msg.textContent='';busy(fIn,true);
      try{start(await call('login',document.getElementById('lgUser').value,document.getElementById('lgPin').value))}catch(err){msg.textContent=String(err&&err.message||err).replace(/^Error: /,'');busy(fIn,false)}};
    fNew.onsubmit=async e=>{e.preventDefault();msg.textContent='';const p1=document.getElementById('nwPin').value,p2=document.getElementById('nwPin2').value;
      if(p1!==p2){msg.textContent='The two PINs don’t match.';return}busy(fNew,true);
      try{start(await call('register',document.getElementById('nwUser').value,p1,document.getElementById('nwTeam').value))}catch(err){msg.textContent=String(err&&err.message||err).replace(/^Error: /,'');busy(fNew,false)}}}
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{});
  const saved=ls.get(TOK);let sess=null;try{sess=saved?JSON.parse(saved):null}catch(e){}
  function boot(){if(sess&&sess.token){start(sess);return}
    let done=false;const go=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;call('publicInfo').then(showLogin).catch(()=>showLogin(null))};
    window.addEventListener('message',e=>{if(done||e.origin!==FD||!e.data||e.data.kz!=='tok')return;let x=null;try{x=JSON.parse(e.data.v)}catch(_){}if(x&&x.token){done=true;sess=x;start(x)}else go()});
    if(window.top===window){go();return}fdPost({kz:'need'});setTimeout(go,900)}
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot);else boot();
})();
</script>

<div class="wrap" id="app"><div class="empty">Loading…</div></div>
<div class="savebar" id="savebar" hidden></div>
<div id="toast" role="status"></div>
<script>
(function(){
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
function h(t,a,...k){const e=document.createElement(t);if(a)for(const x in a){const v=a[x];if(v==null||v===false)continue;if(x==='text')e.textContent=v;else if(x==='class')e.className=v;else if(x.startsWith('on'))e[x]=v;else if(x==='value')e.value=v;else e.setAttribute(x,v===true?'':v)}
  k.flat(9).forEach(c=>{if(c==null||c===false)return;e.append(c.nodeType?c:document.createTextNode(String(c)))});return e}
const num=v=>{const n=parseFloat(String(v==null?'':v).replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g,''));return isFinite(n)?n:0};
const money=n=>'$'+Math.round(num(n)).toLocaleString('en-AU');

function campStep(id){const c=(S.camps||[]).find(x=>x.id===id);const n=String((c&&c.name)||id||'');return /wound/i.test(n)?30:/paraly/i.test(n)?25:0}
function stp(){return S.doc?campStep(S.doc.campaign||S.homeCamp):S.step}
function baseHours(D){return D&&D.roadie?12:10}
let HOURS=10;
function setv(x,k,n,i){const wasWon=hit(i)===true;setTimeout(()=>{if(!wasWon&&hit(i)===true){try{navigator.vibrate&&navigator.vibrate([90,50,90,50,160])}catch(_){}toast('🔥 Hour '+i+' won! Keep it going',2500)}},0);(S.undo=S.undo||[]).push({d:S.date,i,k,v:num(x[k]),sales:(x.sales||[]).slice()});if(S.undo.length>40)S.undo.shift();const prev=num(x[k]);x[k]=Math.max(0,n);
  if(k==='retail'){const sl=x.sales=(x.sales||[]).slice();const nv=x[k];if(nv>prev)sl.push(nv-prev);else{let d=prev-nv;while(d>0&&sl.length){const l=sl.pop();if(l>d){sl.push(l-d);d=0}else d-=l}}}tap();render()}
function undoLast(){const u=(S.undo||[]).pop();if(!u||u.d!==S.date){toast('Nothing to undo');return}slot(u.i)[u.k]=u.v;if(u.sales)slot(u.i).sales=u.sales;S.hour=u.i;tap();render();toast('Undone')}
const SYNC=[[12,0],[15,45],[21,0]];
const S={step:25,date:today(),mode:'tally',hour:null,doc:null,dirty:false,me:null,leader:false,view:'mine',reps:{},team:{},logo:null};
let db,user;
function nextSync(){const n=new Date(),m=n.getHours()*60+n.getMinutes();const x=SYNC.find(([a,b])=>a*60+b>m);return x?((x[0]%12||12)+':'+pad(x[1])+(x[0]<12?'am':'pm')):null}
function blankDoc(){return{date:S.date,site:'',grateful:'',towards:'',notes:'',targets:{},slots:{}}}
function slot(i){const k=String(i);return S.doc.slots[k]=S.doc.slots[k]||{}}
function totals(upto){const t={};F.forEach(f=>t[f.k]=0);let n=0;for(let i=1;i<=(upto||99);i++){const x=S.doc.slots[String(i)];if(!x)continue;if(F.some(f=>num(x[f.k])))n++;F.forEach(f=>t[f.k]+=num(x[f.k]))}t.hours=n;return t}
function syncSH(){const el=document.querySelector('[aria-label="Shift hours"]')||[...document.querySelectorAll('input')].find(i=>i.dataset&&i.dataset.k==='shiftHours');if(el&&S.doc)el.value=S.doc.targets.shiftHours||''}
function fromTimes(D){const m=t=>/^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$/.test(t||'')?t.split(':').map(Number).reduce((x,y)=>x*60+y):null;const a=m(D.start),b=m(D.finish);if(a==null||b==null)return;let d=b-a;if(d<=0)d+=1440;if(d>300)d-=30;D.targets.shiftHours=String(Math.round(d/60*4)/4)}
function hourTarget(){const tg=num(S.doc.targets.retail),sh=num(S.doc.targets.shiftHours)||8;return tg>0?tg/sh:0}
const WIN={stops:3,buyers:2,retail:150};
function winCount(x){return (num(x.stops)>=WIN.stops)+(num(x.buyers)>=WIN.buyers)+(num(x.retail)>=WIN.retail)}
function hit(i){const x=S.doc.slots[String(i)];if(!x||!F.some(f=>num(x[f.k])))return null;return winCount(x)>=2}
function startMin(){const t=S.doc&&(S.doc.startType==='office'?(S.doc.field||'10:00'):S.doc.start);if(!t||!/^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$/.test(t))return null;const [a]=t.split(':').map(Number);return a*60}
function clockHour(){if(S.date!==today())return null;const st=startMin();if(st==null)return null;const n=new Date();const m=n.getHours()*60+n.getMinutes()-st;if(m<0)return 1;return Math.min(HOURS,Math.floor(m/60)+1)}
function hourRange(i){const st=startMin();if(st==null)return '';const f=m=>{m=((m%1440)+1440)%1440;const hh=Math.floor(m/60),mm=m%60;return (hh%12||12)+(mm?':'+pad(mm):'')+(hh<12?'am':'pm')};return f(st+(i-1)*60)+'–'+f(st+i*60)}
function ensureStart(){if(S.doc&&!S.doc.start&&S.date===today()){const n=new Date();S.doc.start=pad(n.getHours())+':'+pad(n.getMinutes())}}
function curHour(){const c=clockHour();if(c)return c;const keys=Object.keys(S.doc.slots).map(Number).filter(i=>F.some(f=>num(S.doc.slots[i][f.k])));return keys.length?Math.min(HOURS,Math.max(...keys)):1}
function tap(){if(S.doc)S.doc.lastTap=Date.now();markDirty()}
let saveT=null;function lsKey(){return 'kaizen_hourly_'+(S.me&&S.me.id)+'_'+S.date}
function backup(){try{localStorage.setItem(lsKey(),JSON.stringify({at:Date.now(),doc:S.doc}))}catch(_){}}
function markDirty(){if(S.doc)backup();clearTimeout(saveT);saveT=setTimeout(()=>{if(S.dirty)save(true)},2500);if(S.doc&&Object.values(S.doc.slots).some(x=>F.some(f=>num(x[f.k]))))ensureStart();S.dirty=true;renderBar()}
async function load(){S.doc=null;render();try{const d=await db.doc(`reps/${S.me.id}/hourly/${S.date}`).get();S.doc=d.exists?Object.assign(blankDoc(),JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d.data()))):blankDoc();
    if(!d.exists){try{const prev=await db.doc(`reps/${S.me.id}/hourly/${addDays(S.date,-1)}`).get();if(prev.exists){const p=prev.data();S.doc.site=p.site||'';S.doc.targets=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(p.targets||{}))}}catch(_){}}}
  catch(e){S.doc=blankDoc()}
  try{const b=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(lsKey())||'null');const srv=Date.parse(S.doc.updatedAt||0)||0;if(b&&b.doc&&b.at>srv+1000){S.doc=Object.assign(blankDoc(),b.doc);setTimeout(()=>{S.dirty=true;save(true)},500)}}catch(_){}
  S.doc.targets=S.doc.targets||{};S.doc.slots=S.doc.slots||{};S.hour=curHour();S.dirty=false;render()}
function bellAmt(){const v=Number((S.std||{}).bell);return v>0?v:700}function gongAmt(){const v=Number((S.std||{}).gong);return v>0?v:1000}
function levels(){const l=((S.cele||{}).list||[]).filter(x=>Number(x.amt)>0);return (l.length?l:[{emoji:'🔔',label:'BELL',amt:bellAmt()},{emoji:'🥁',label:'GONG',amt:gongAmt()}]).map(x=>({emoji:x.emoji||'🎉',label:String(x.label||'').toUpperCase()||'NICE',amt:Number(x.amt)})).sort((a,b)=>a.amt-b.amt)}
function levelFor(r){let hit=null;levels().forEach(l=>{if(r>=l.amt)hit=l});return hit}
function ringFor(r){const l=levelFor(r);return l?l.emoji+' '+l.label:''}
function celebrate(l){const o=h('div',{style:'position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(20,26,45,.6)',onclick:()=>o.remove()},
  h('div',{style:'background:#2E3A59;color:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:28px 34px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.35);animation:pop .4s ease'},
    h('div',{style:'font-size:4rem;line-height:1',text:l.emoji}),h('div',{style:'font-family:var(--display);font-size:2rem;font-weight:700;color:#F5B56E;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-top:8px',text:l.label+'!'}),
    h('div',{style:'margin-top:4px',text:money(l.amt)+'+ today. Huge!'})));document.body.append(o);setTimeout(()=>o.remove(),4000)}
function checkRing(){if(!S.doc||S.date!==today())return;const l=levelFor(totals().retail);if(l&&Number(S.doc.rungAmt||0)<l.amt){S.doc.rungAmt=l.amt;celebrate(l)}}
async function save(quiet){if(!S.doc)return;checkRing();const clean={};for(const k in S.doc.slots){const x={};F.forEach(f=>{const v=num(S.doc.slots[k][f.k]);if(v)x[f.k]=v});const sl=(S.doc.slots[k].sales||[]).map(num).filter(v=>v>0);if(sl.length&&x.retail)x.sales=sl;if(Object.keys(x).length)clean[k]=x}

  try{await db.doc(`reps/${S.me.id}/hourly/${S.date}`).set(body);S.doc.updatedAt=body.updatedAt;S.dirty=false;S.savedAt=Date.now();try{localStorage.removeItem(lsKey())}catch(_){}if(S.date===today())pushStreak();if(!quiet)toast('Saved');renderBar()}catch(e){toast('Couldn’t save — check your signal and try again')}
  const late=S.date<today()||new Date().getHours()>=21;if(late)await syncNow(true)}
async function syncNow(quiet){if(S.dirty)await save(true);const t=totals();const ref=db.doc(`reps/${S.me.id}/entries/${S.date}`);let prev={};try{const p=await ref.get();if(p.exists)prev=p.data()}catch(_){}
  const d=new Date(S.date+'T12:00:00');const wd=(d.getDay()+6)%7;d.setDate(d.getDate()-wd);
  const body={...prev,date:S.date,week:toStr(d),month:S.date.slice(0,7),updatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),fromHourly:true,roadie:!!S.doc.roadie,hours:num(prev.hours)>0?num(prev.hours):(num(S.doc.targets.shiftHours)||8)};
  ['stops','buyers','retail','upsells','upsellRetail','medals'].forEach(k=>body[k]=t[k]);if(S.doc.campaign)body.campaign=S.doc.campaign;if(String(S.doc.cash||'').trim())body.cash=num(S.doc.cash);if(String(S.doc.eftpos||'').trim())body.eftpos=num(S.doc.eftpos);
  try{await ref.set(body);S.doc.syncedAt=body.updatedAt;await db.doc(`reps/${S.me.id}/hourly/${S.date}`).set({...S.doc,syncedAt:body.updatedAt});if(!quiet)toast('Synced to Orexis KPIs');render()}catch(e){toast('Couldn’t sync — try again')}}
/* ---------- views ---------- */
function header(){return h('div',{class:'top'},S.logo?h('img',{src:S.logo,alt:''}):null,h('div',null,h('h1',{text:'Orexis Hourly'}),h('div',{class:'sub',text:S.me?S.me.name:''})),h('div',{class:'sp'}),
  h('a',{href:'https://ameliahcrowe-cloud.github.io/kaizen-kpis/orexis/',target:'_top',class:'ib','aria-label':'Open your day log',title:'Day log',onclick:()=>{if(S.dirty){backup();save(true)}}},h('span',{'aria-hidden':'true'},'📋')),
  h('button',{class:'ib','aria-label':'Log out',title:'Log out',onclick:()=>window.kaizenLogout&&window.kaizenLogout()},h('span',{'aria-hidden':'true'},'⎋')))}
function dayBar(){const t=today(),d=S.date;const rel=d===t?'Today':d===addDays(t,-1)?'Yesterday':'';
  const go=n=>{if(S.dirty)save(true);S.date=addDays(S.date,n);S.view==='team'?loadTeam():load()};
  return h('div',{class:'daybar'},h('button',{'aria-label':'Previous day',onclick:()=>go(-1)},'‹'),h('div',{class:'d'},nice(d,{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'short'}),h('small',{text:rel})),
    d!==t?h('button',{style:'font-size:.85rem',onclick:()=>{if(S.dirty)save(true);S.date=t;S.view==='team'?loadTeam():load()}},'Today'):null,h('button',{'aria-label':'Next day',onclick:()=>go(1)},'›'))}
function field(label,obj,key,ph,area,type){const el=h(area?'textarea':'input',{placeholder:ph||'','aria-label':label,type:type||'text',inputmode:type==='num'?'decimal':null,oninput:e=>{obj[key]=e.target.value;markDirty()}});
  if(type==='num')el.type='text';el.value=obj[key]==null?'':obj[key];return h('label',null,h('span',{class:'lbl',text:label}),el)}
function threeList(label,D,key,old){if(!Array.isArray(D[key])){D[key]=['','',''];if(D[old])D[key][0]=D[old]}
  return h('div',{style:'margin-top:12px'},h('span',{class:'lbl',text:label}),h('div',{style:'display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px'},[0,1,2].map(i=>{const el=h('input',{type:'text',placeholder:(i+1)+'.','aria-label':label+' '+(i+1),oninput:e=>{D[key][i]=e.target.value;markDirty()}});el.value=D[key][i]||'';return el})))}
function streaks(){let cur=0,best=0,run=0;const last=Math.max(0,...Object.keys(S.doc.slots).map(Number).filter(i=>F.some(f=>num(S.doc.slots[i][f.k]))));
  for(let i=1;i<=last;i++){if(hit(i)===true){run++;best=Math.max(best,run)}else run=0}cur=run;return{cur,best}}
function inStreak(n){return hit(n)===true}
async function pushStreak(){try{const st=streaks();const ref=db.doc('board/'+S.me.id);const d=await ref.get();const o=(d.exists&&d.data().streak)||{};
  if(o.date===S.date&&o.best===st.best&&o.cur===st.cur)return;const sv={date:S.date,best:st.best,cur:st.cur,name:S.me.name};d.exists?await ref.update({streak:sv}):await ref.set({name:S.me.name,streak:sv})}catch(_){}}
function streakComp(){if(!S.board)return null;const rows=Object.entries(S.board).map(([id,b])=>({id,n:(b&&b.name)||(b&&b.streak&&b.streak.name)||'Rep',st:b&&b.streak})).filter(x=>x.st&&x.st.date===S.date&&x.st.best>=1).sort((p,q)=>q.st.best-p.st.best||q.st.cur-p.st.cur);
  return h('div',{class:'card',style:'padding:10px 14px'},h('div',{style:'display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline'},h('b',{text:'🔥 Hot streak comp'}),h('span',{class:'hint',style:'font-size:.75rem',text:'Most hours won in a row today'})),
    rows.length?h('div',{style:'display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;margin-top:6px'},rows.slice(0,8).map((x,i)=>h('div',{style:'display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.9rem'+(x.id===S.me.id?';font-weight:800':'')},
      h('span',{style:'display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px'},(i===0?'🥇':i===1?'🥈':i===2?'🥉':(i+1)+'.'),(()=>{const b=S.board[x.id]||{};const p=b.photo&&String(b.photo).startsWith('data:image/')?b.photo:null;return p?h('img',{src:p,alt:'',style:'width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid var(--line)'}):h('span',{'aria-hidden':'true',style:'width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#2E3A59;color:#F5B56E;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;font-size:9px',text:x.n.trim().split(/\s+/).map(y=>y[0]).slice(0,2).join('').toUpperCase()})})(),x.n),h('span',{text:'🔥'.repeat(Math.min(x.st.best,5))+' '+x.st.best+(x.st.cur>=1?' · on one now':'')})))):h('div',{class:'hint',style:'font-size:.8rem;margin-top:4px',text:'No one’s won an hour yet today. Be the first!'}))}
function rosterHrs(){const sh=num(S.doc.targets.shiftHours)||8;if(S.date!==today())return sh;const st=startMin();if(st==null)return totals().hours?Math.min(sh,totals().hours):0;const n=new Date();const m=n.getHours()*60+n.getMinutes()-st;return Math.max(0.5,Math.min(sh,m/60))}
function goalCard(){const T=S.doc.targets;const goal=num(T.retail);if(!goal)return null;
  const t=totals();const left=Math.max(0,goal-t.retail);const pc=Math.min(100,t.retail/goal*100);const sh=num(T.shiftHours)||8;

  if(S.leader){db.collection('reps').onSnapshot(sn=>{const o={};sn.docs.forEach(d=>o[d.id]=d.data());S.reps=o})}
  try{db.collection('board').onSnapshot(sn=>{const o={};sn.docs.forEach(d=>o[d.id]=d.data());S.board=o;if(S.view==='mine'&&!S.dirty)render()})}catch(_){}
  try{const md=await db.doc('reps/'+S.me.id).get();S.prefs=(md.exists&&md.data().eodPrefs)||{strategies:[],habits:[]};const cfg=await db.doc('settings/campaigns').get();const def=cfg.exists&&cfg.data().def||'paralympics';const camp=(md.exists&&md.data().campaign)||def;let l=(cfg.exists&&cfg.data().list)||[];if(!l.length)l=[{id:'paralympics',name:'Paralympics'}];if(!l.some(c=>/wound/i.test(c.name||c.id)))l=l.concat([{id:'wounded',name:'Wounded Heroes'}]);{const seen={};l=l.filter(c=>{const k=String(c.name||c.id).trim().toLowerCase();if(seen[k])return false;seen[k]=1;return true})}S.camps=l.filter(c=>c.active!==false||/wound|paraly/i.test(c.name||c.id));S.homeCamp=camp;S.step=campStep(camp)}catch(_){S.step=25;S.camps=[{id:'paralympics',name:'Paralympics'},{id:'wounded',name:'Wounded Heroes'}];S.homeCamp='paralympics'}
  load();setTimeout(loadPast,1500);
  setInterval(()=>{if(S.dirty&&S.view==='mine')save(true)},60000);
  setInterval(()=>{if(S.view!=='mine'||!S.doc||S.mode!=='tally')return;const c=clockHour();if(!c||c===S.hour)return;if(S.manual&&Date.now()-S.manual<10*60000)return;
    if(S.dirty)save(true);const was=S.hour;S.hour=c;S.manual=0;render();if(c>was){toast('Hour '+c+' has started');if(S.doc.slots[String(was)]&&F.some(f=>num(S.doc.slots[String(was)][f.k])))checkIn(was);try{navigator.vibrate&&navigator.vibrate(150)}catch(_){}}},20000);
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.visibilityState==='hidden'&&S.dirty)save(true)});
  window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>{if(S.dirty){backup();save(true)}});window.addEventListener('beforeunload',()=>{if(S.dirty){backup();save(true)}});
})();
})();
</script>
